title: Web foundations
description: Weeks 1–6 · HTML5 structure and semantic tags, accessibility basics, CSS3 fundamentals, the box model, Flexbox, Grid, responsive design, media queries, and mobile-first layouts.
tags: Mini project: static responsive landing page

title: JavaScript & developer tools
description: Weeks 7–12 · Variables, functions, arrays, objects, loops, browser DevTools, VS Code setup, and Git/GitHub basics. Mini project: build a static responsive landing page.

title: Modern JavaScript
description: Weeks 13–18 · ES6+ let/const, arrow functions, destructuring, spread/rest, modules and imports/exports, Promises, async/await, fetch, DOM events, browser storage, JSON, and forms. Mini project: an interactive to-do app.

title: React setup & first interactions
description: Weeks 19–24 · Handling events and forms, controlled components, and setting up a React project with Vite or CRA. Mini project: a counter app or product-card UI.

title: React fundamentals
description: Weeks 25–30 · React, component-based architecture, JSX, components, props, state, rendering lists, and conditional rendering.

title: Hooks & reusable components
description: Weeks 31–36 · useState, useEffect, useRef, useMemo, and useCallback; component composition, reusable UI, custom hooks, lifting state, and prop-drilling basics. Mini project: a weather app or notes app.

title: Routing & project evaluation
description: Weeks 37–42 · React Router basics, nested and dynamic routes, route parameters, protected routes, and 404 pages. Project-based evaluation I covers lectures 1–42.

title: Multi-page SPA design
description: Weeks 43–48 · Navigation layouts, page structure, multi-page single-page-app design, and route-based composition. Mini project: a portfolio site with routing.

title: Shared state & async UI
description: Weeks 49–54 · Context API, React state architecture, global vs local state, an introduction to Redux Toolkit or Zustand, and async loading/error handling. Mini project: a shopping cart or dashboard.

title: Forms & validation
description: Weeks 55–60 · Form handling in React, validation strategies, and reusable input components.

title: Interactive UI patterns
description: Weeks 61–66 · Modals, tabs, dropdowns, toast notifications, and search/filter/sort patterns. Mini project: a registration form with validation.

title: APIs & data-driven apps
description: Weeks 67–72 · REST APIs with fetch/axios, loading states, retries, error handling, pagination, infinite scroll, debounce, CRUD workflows, and third-party APIs. Mini project: a movie-search app or GitHub profile viewer.
